cohort: All women giving birth in Uruguay (pregnancies ≥22 weeks and weights ≥500 g) with valid data in the mode of childbirth recorded in the Perinatal Information System database between 2008 and 2018
finding: Uruguay is experiencing an increasing caesarean section trend, even in groups of women who have a lower risk of requiring a caesarean section.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates were higher in the private sector for all Robson groups throughout the study period, except for women in group 9.
